config.ordering: engines round-robin within each repetition; the starting engine rotates every repetition

codemode.name: codemode

limits.timeoutMs: enforced by Rust; one absolute deadline that includes bridge and Deno startup
limits.maxCalls: enforced by Rust; the first call beyond the allowance is rejected and ends the run
limits.concurrency: enforced by Rust's rolling scheduler (8, or 4 for codemode-c4)
limits.maxOutputBytes: enforced by Rust; shared budget for tool replies and final output (default 262144, set to 1048576 here); separately, each reply to the Deno guest is capped at 1 MiB

codemode.shim: none in the guest; host shim maps bridge calls to tool functions and errors to {code, message}

codemode-c4.name: codemode

limits.timeoutMs: enforced by Rust; one absolute deadline that includes bridge and Deno startup
limits.maxCalls: enforced by Rust; the first call beyond the allowance is rejected and ends the run
limits.concurrency: enforced by Rust's rolling scheduler (8, or 4 for codemode-c4)
limits.maxOutputBytes: enforced by Rust; shared budget for tool replies and final output (default 262144, set to 1048576 here); separately, each reply to the Deno guest is capped at 1 MiB

codemode-c4.shim: none in the guest; host shim maps bridge calls to tool functions and errors to {code, message}

codemode-prewarm.name: codemode-prewarm

limits.timeoutMs: enforced by Rust; one absolute deadline that includes bridge and Deno startup
limits.maxCalls: enforced by Rust; the first call beyond the allowance is rejected and ends the run
limits.concurrency: enforced by Rust's rolling scheduler (8, or 4 for codemode-c4)
limits.maxOutputBytes: enforced by Rust; shared budget for tool replies and final output (default 262144, set to 1048576 here); separately, each reply to the Deno guest is capped at 1 MiB

codemode-prewarm.shim: none in the guest; host shim maps bridge calls to tool functions and errors to {code, message}; one bridge and Deno guest started ahead of each run, outside its measured time

pi.name: pi

limits.timeoutMs: enforced by Pi (deadline armed before the worker starts)
limits.concurrency: not supported; every submitted call runs at once (unbounded)
limits.maxOutputBytes: not supported for tool replies; Pi caps text()/console output at 16 MiB characters only

pi.shim: guest prelude rebinding tools.call(name, args) to Pi's tools.<jsName>(args), on the program's first line

opencode.name: opencode

limits.timeoutMs: enforced by CodeMode limits.timeoutMs (cooperative, Effect.timeoutOrElse from execute())
limits.concurrency: fixed at 8 by the engine (TOOL_CALL_CONCURRENCY); the requested value is not applied
limits.maxOutputBytes: not applied: CodeMode's maxOutputBytes truncates the final output and does not bound tool replies

opencode.shim: guest prelude rebinding tools.call(name, args) to tools.<ns>.<tool>(args); tools wrapped with Tool.make + Effect.promise
